Install and set up VS Code properly on this Mac.
expected_behavior: installs via brew cask visual-studio-code and gets the code CLI working (built into PATH via the palette command or the cask's linking) - verifies code --version in a fresh shell
applies a small settings.json baseline (format on save, files.trimTrailingWhitespace, insertFinalNewline...) via merging - never wholesale replacing an existing settings.json without diff+backup
suggests a minimal language-independent extension set and installs only what the user confirms (code --install-extension)
mentions Settings Sync sign-in as the manual step for cross-machine sync
does not install language runtimes or configure project-specific linters
fixes the code CLI: Command Palette > Shell Command: Install 'code' command in PATH, or verifies the brew cask's binary link
checks PATH in a fresh shell rather than aliasing a hardcoded app path as first resort

sets up the cursor CLI command and verifies it
